gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-finlandica: Shantell Sans leads with a wide, hand-drawn mouth and a single nib width that never changes. Finlandica follows in a plain sans, quietly outlined.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-fustat: Shantell Sans comes in loose and expressive, drawn with one fixed nib width. And Fustat, with lines like bent tubing and wide gaps where its c ends, keeps a long read smooth.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-gantari: Gantari looks like bent wire, with wide openings in its curves. Shantell Sans is best at showy, hand-pen character in the heading, while Gantari does its best work as a plain sans for steady paragraphs.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-gayathri: Approachable is the first word for Gayathri, whose curved letters end open and carry a mild letterpress-style thickening. Gayathri reads gently over a long passage, a soft counterpoint to the unvarying pen line of Shantell Sans.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-google-sans: Google Sans reads smooth and uniform, with no thick-thin shift and terminals pulled well back. And a longer passage moves along easily under the bouncy, expressive lettering of Shantell Sans.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-google-sans-flex: Marker-bold charm up top, in Shantell Sans, with its wide mouths and one fixed nib width, then crisp ribbon-cut endings below. Google Sans Flex keeps the page tidy.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-gothic-a1: Gothic A1 reads friendly and businesslike, with a splayed c terminal. Over a long passage this plain sans stays low in contrast, a quiet foil to the single-width strokes of Shantell Sans.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-gotu: Playful pen shapes meet sturdy hairlines here, as Shantell Sans keeps its arches matched to its stems while Gotu thins its joins gently. Gotu holds up across a full page.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-gowun-dodum: Round, tube-smooth and friendly, Gowun Dodum has a wide-mouthed a. Shantell Sans supplies the swagger in the heading, and the sans-serif text lets that personality breathe.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-gruppo: Pen pressure never wavers in Shantell Sans, from first letter to last. It brings the loud personality up top, while Gruppo, a sans with low contrast and curve endings that never near each other, supplies the restraint.
